title: Oven Roasted Thai Tofu Bowl
description: A citrusy, crispy bowl featuring roasted tofu, fresh veggies, and plant-based friendly flavors.
instructions: Drain tofu, press to remove moisture, and cut into 1-inch cubes.
In a bowl, whisk sesame oil, soy sauce, lime juice, grated ginger, minced garlic, and a pinch of salt.
Toss tofu cubes in the sauce, ensuring even coating, then spread them on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Roast tofu for 25 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden and crisp.
While tofu roasts, steam or microwave cooked brown rice until heated through.
In a mixing bowl, combine roasted peanuts, shredded cucumber, shredded carrot, and basil leaves.
Once tofu is done, transfer it to the bowl with the veggies and drizzle any remaining sauce over the top.
Serve the tofu mixture over a bed of warm brown rice, garnish with lime slices, and squeeze extra lime juice if desired.
Toss gently before eating, and enjoy a bright, crunchy Thai-inspired bowl.
